The '''Nayli Spaceport''' was the a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] located in the [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrilan]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Nayli]]. It could fit ten bulk [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] at one time.<ref name="SoR" />
